description: Macronutrients, micronutrients, dietary guidelines, and food science

types.simple: Monosaccharides and disaccharides; quick energy (glucose, fructose, sucrose)
types.fiber: Indigestible; gut health, blood sugar regulation; 25–38 g/day recommended

carbohydrates.glycemic_index: Measure of how quickly food raises blood glucose; low GI foods preferred for sustained energy

proteins.function: Building blocks; muscle, enzymes, hormones, antibodies

amino_acids.essential: 9 that must come from diet (histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, valine)

proteins.complete_proteins: Contain all essential amino acids; animal products, quinoa, soy
proteins.recommended: 0.8 g/kg body weight (sedentary); 1.6–2.2 g/kg for athletes

fats.function: Energy storage, hormone production, fat-soluble vitamin absorption, cell membranes

types.saturated: Solid at room temp; animal products; raise LDL cholesterol
types.monounsaturated: Liquid at room temp; olive oil, avocado; heart-healthy

polyunsaturated.omega_3: EPA, DHA, ALA; anti-inflammatory; fish, flaxseed, walnuts
polyunsaturated.omega_6: Linoleic acid; vegetable oils; pro-inflammatory in excess

types.trans_fat: Industrial hydrogenation; worst for heart; largely banned

fat_soluble_vitamins.vitamin_A: Vision, immune function; liver, orange vegetables (as beta-carotene)
fat_soluble_vitamins.vitamin_D: Calcium absorption, bone health, immune function; sunlight, fatty fish
fat_soluble_vitamins.vitamin_K: Blood clotting, bone health; leafy greens

water_soluble_vitamins.vitamin_C: Antioxidant, collagen synthesis, immune function; citrus, bell peppers
water_soluble_vitamins.B3_niacin: Energy metabolism, DNA repair; meat, fish, peanuts
water_soluble_vitamins.B9_folate: DNA synthesis, neural tube development; leafy greens, legumes
water_soluble_vitamins.B12_cobalamin: Nerve function, red blood cells; animal products only (vegans must supplement)

major_minerals.calcium: Bones, muscle contraction, nerve signals; dairy, leafy greens; 1000 mg/day
major_minerals.iron: Hemoglobin; red meat, legumes, fortified foods; 8–18 mg/day
major_minerals.magnesium: 300+ enzymatic reactions; nuts, seeds, whole grains
major_minerals.potassium: Blood pressure, fluid balance; bananas, potatoes, legumes

dietary_patterns.mediterranean: High in olive oil, vegetables, legumes, fish; low red meat; linked to reduced cardiovascular disease
dietary_patterns.dash: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension; low sodium, high potassium
dietary_patterns.plant_based: Emphasizes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, legumes; reduces chronic disease risk
dietary_patterns.ketogenic: Very low carb (<50g/day), high fat; puts body in ketosis; weight loss tool
dietary_patterns.intermittent_fasting: Cycles of eating and fasting; 16:8 (eat within 8 hours), 5:2 (2 low-calorie days)

energy_balance.calories: Unit of energy; 1 food calorie = 1 kilocalorie (kcal)
energy_balance.bmr: Basal Metabolic Rate; calories burned at complete rest
energy_balance.tdee: Total Daily Energy Expenditure; BMR × activity factor
energy_balance.weight_management: Caloric deficit → weight loss; caloric surplus → weight gain; 3,500 kcal ≈ 0.45 kg fat

food_safety_nutrition.ultra_processed: NOVA classification group 4; industrial additives; linked to chronic disease
food_safety_nutrition.organic_vs_conventional: Minimal nutritional difference; organic avoids synthetic pesticides
food_safety_nutrition.superfoods: Marketing term; nutrient-dense foods (blueberries, salmon, kale, quinoa)
